title: Disentangling the Drivers of LLM Social Conformity: An Uncertainty-Moderated Dual-Process Mechanism

bias_targets.methodology: Adapting an information cascade paradigm from behavioral economics to quantitatively measure the decision weights LLMs assign to public signals (majority opinions of other advisors) versus private evidence across medical, legal, and investment scenarios under varying levels of uncertainty.

Explicitly labeling the sources of public advice as either human advisors or AI advisors in the prompts and using a linear mixed-effects model to evaluate whether LLMs exhibit an in-group preference by weighting human information differently from AI information.
